svg.title: Automation: the pipeline that builds this profile
svg.desc: A terminal floating in 3D space runs node scripts/gen-profile.mjs, listing the generated assets (hero-banner.svg 18.4 kB, typing-anim.svg 21.9 kB, stack-client.svg 22.5 kB, stack-server.svg 29.1 kB, galaxy/*.svg 32.3 kB, section-divider.svg 1.5 kB), then node --test scripts/*.test.mjs with render-metrics and gen-profile tests ok, then git push origin main. A panel of asset-size bars grows as each file prints, and a git graph gains a new commit on main when the push completes.
